Son Tayeon seeks to mark the overlapping names on the refugee citizenship roster and the restoration service registration so that one person is not counted as two laborers.
The player can cross-check the overlapping names on the two rosters with Son Tayeon, or leave in the next records officer's memo the lines to be verified against Kim Nayul's shift schedule.

Son Tayeon cross-checks the two rosters before the same name is counted as two laborers.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Registration & Records
- Rank: Guild Member
- Title: Restoration Service Recorder
**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up at the Seoul Station Registry Office. The post of Restoration Service Records Officer opened with the deletion of one line in the double ledger.
- Work location: Guro 2-dong. At the duty desk in Guro 2-dong, Son Tayeon cross-checks Baek On's refugee citizenship roster against the restoration service registration in name order. He re-matches the names that overlap on both rosters against Kim Nayul's shift schedule and leaves the result in the next records officer's handover memo.

**Office.** Rank: Guild Member.

**Relationships.** Gim Nayul checks the actual shifts and registrations so that the same person does not remain as two laborers.
